descriptions.en: Charged, fast and explodes almost at once.
descriptions.de: Geladen, schnell und explodiert fast sofort.
descriptions.es: Cargado, rápido y explota casi al instante.
descriptions.fr: Chargé, rapide, et explose presque aussitôt.
descriptions.ms: Bercas, laju dan meletup hampir serta-merta.
descriptions.tr: Yüklü, hızlı ve neredeyse anında patlar.
descriptions.zh: 带电、速度快，几乎立刻爆炸。
